summary: Företag 21 Scientific develops automated monitoring systems for laboratory animals used in preclinical research. Its platform enables continuous, non-invasive tracking of animal health and behavior to improve data quality and animal welfare.
partnership_signal: active research and customer collaboration partnerships
target_market: Global preclinical research and laboratory animal monitoring market
strategy_notes: Focused on digitizing preclinical studies through automated monitoring and data collection systems that improve study quality while supporting the principles of reduction, refinement and replacement in animal research.
technology_notes: Develops hardware and software that continuously monitors laboratory animals, including tracking of weight, activity and health-related parameters in group-housed environments.
risk_notes: Dependent on adoption by research organizations, regulatory and ethical developments in animal research, commercialization execution and competition from established laboratory monitoring providers.
